scope.contract: Original I-005 / s3 already defines MoveClips{includeLinks:bool} (default true) and LinkGroup.syncPolicy preserve|allowOutOfSync. This slice opens includeLinks=false: a move (including pointer/snap preview and the three collision modes) applies only to the explicit IDs, does not expand unselected AV link partners or unselected selection-group members, marks a partially moved LinkGroup syncPolicy=allowOutOfSync, and does not rewrite stored offsets. Default includeLinks=true is unchanged. Ripple trim/delete still always include links. Insert-mode MoveClips still leaves a source gap; explicit range close is unchanged. Auto-close-on-move is still not a legal MoveClips mode. New-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, caption cue-follow, marker business, and I-006 roll/slip/slide are not implemented. No new persistence table.
scope.temporalSemantics: includeLinks=false uses the explicit ID set only. When some but not all members of a LinkGroup move, syncPolicy becomes allowOutOfSync and recorded offsets stay as originally stored; LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH is not issued for that policy. Moving every member does not mark the group out of sync. Admission still requires a two-member AV link and now accepts preserve or allowOutOfSync. Overwrite group repair keeps a complete two-member group even when syncPolicy is allowOutOfSync. Locked unmoved partners are not a reason to refuse an ignore-links move of a selected clip; a locked selected member still FIELD_LOCKED for the whole request. Reject, overwrite and insert all honor the flag and stay distinct. Source time, effect curves, proxy, admitted absolute captions, and audio offsets of unmoved members are left in place.
scope.preserved: Leave-gap delete/trim, single-range ripple delete and close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, and reject/overwrite/insert remain distinct. Insert-move still leaves a source hole. Whole-group atomic refusal. Writer-fence / revision / SQL trigger rollback unchanged.
scope.history: One persistent MoveClips command; existing journal undo/redo; save, reopen, archive fork, AAC MP4 export on the existing paths.
scope.ui: Workbench checkbox “Ignore links and groups this move” (key move-ignore-links) and Alt held at pointer-down are captured for the whole gesture, including selection expansion, snap planning and commit. The checkbox is disabled while a gesture is active. foundation-scroll uses ScrollCacheExtent.pixels(8000) so the top undo/redo row stays mounted when the page is tall.
